on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

  EXE: "bin/barrnap --threads 4"

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -el {0}

      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@v3

          activate-environment: mlst

          channels: conda-forge,bioconda
          conda-remove-defaults: true
          channel-priority: strict
          auto-update-conda: true

      - name: Check tools
        run: |
          set +x
          blastn -version
          any2fasta -v
          makeblastdb -version

      - name: Run BATS suite
        run: bats -T --abort test/test.sh", "rationale": "Add an explicit job timeout to the single build job, matching the P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern evidenced by measured CI workflow experiments (added timeout-minutes: 5 with preserved successes and reduced elapsed time). This bounds runaway consumption without removing any build/test steps, so coverage is unchanged, and it introduces no new privileges, secrets, network access, or deployment steps.", "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]}
